facts.fact: The Global Network Initiative says Zambia's Cyber Security Act of 2025, signed by President Hichilema on 8 April 2025, sets up a Cyber Security Agency under the President and Cyber Incident Response Teams.

The Global Network Initiative says Zambia's Parliament enacted the Cyber Security Act and the Cyber Crimes Act of 2025 in April 2025 and the President signed them into law on 8 April 2025, after the bills were first tabled in November 2024.
facts.system: Cyber Security Act 2025 and Cyber Crimes Act 2025

ZMB.note: Only civil society concern about the absence of comprehensive data protection in the cyber bills; no data protection law or bill is stated.
Nothing on an ICT sector policy.
Civil society opposition is described without a named group inside the country, and no cut or punishment is stated; speech offences are noted, not used.
No local research institution is named.

facts.fact: The Global Network Initiative says Zambia's Cyber Security Act and Cyber Crimes Act of 2025 were developed and deliberated with minimal transparency and public participation, and that civil society concerns raised after the November 2024 tabling were not meaningfully addressed before enactment.
facts.system: Cyber Security Act and Cyber Crimes Act 2025
